intro.fr: Mega Man Battle Network 2 a un outil de personnalisation, Network Customizer, qui sert aussi de randomizer.
intro.en: Mega Man Battle Network 2 has a customization tool, Network Customizer, that also works as a randomizer.

text.fr: Capcom sort Mega Man Battle Network 2 sur Game Boy Advance en 2001.
text.en: Capcom releases Mega Man Battle Network 2 on Game Boy Advance in 2001.

text.fr: seeliefae publie en décembre 2019 Network Customizer V2, page web qui personnalise de nombreux aspects de la version nord-américaine du jeu ; rando-list le classe parmi les randomizers.
text.en: seeliefae releases Network Customizer V2 in December 2019, a web page that customizes many aspects of the North American version of the game; rando-list lists it among randomizers.
